title: Employment Situation (Aug 2027 data) — 08:30 ET, into Labor Day weekend and the day before the September FOMC blackout opens
source: EST: derived from BLS's own published scheduling rule — release on the third Friday following the end of the reference week (the Sun-Sat week containing the 12th) — using the implementation this proposer re-wrote and re-validated from scratch on 2026-09-09, 7 for 7 against the four confirmed jobs-* entries on this calendar (2026-09-04, 2026-10-02, 2026-11-06, 2026-12-04) and the three historical Sunday-July-4 releases (2004-07-02, 2010-07-02, 2021-07-02). For August 2027 the reference week is Sun 2027-08-08 to Sat 2027-08-14, and the third Friday after 08-14 is 2027-09-03. The prefix is EST: and not BLS: because bls.gov returned HTTP 403 on all four schedule routes re-tried on 2026-09-09 and fred.stlouisfed.org returned 404 — recorded in jobs-2027-08-06's probe-ref.blocked. A derived date is not a published one
notes: PROPOSED BY jobs-2027-08-06's initial research (2026-09-09) at D+28 — outside the 5-day corridor, and proposed anyway because it is the fact that makes the proposer's own structural leg checkable: with this print on 2027-09-03 and the FOMC on 2027-09-15 (FED: federalreserve.gov's own 2027 calendar, fetched 2026-09-09), jobs-2027-08-06 is the FIRST of exactly two payrolls that meeting sees and this is the second. WHY IT IS SAFE TO DERIVE HERE: the rule's one documented failure mode is a holiday landing on the rule's own Friday. 2027-09-03 is an ordinary Friday; the nearest holiday is Labor Day on Mon 2027-09-06, which follows it and never displaces it (the rule reproduced 2026-09-04 into the identical shape, one of the four confirmed knowns). TWO ADJACENCIES A LATER LANE SHOULD NOT HAVE TO REDISCOVER. (1) It lands into a 3-day weekend, so it is a member of the exact set jobs-2027-07-02's initial research measured — the reopen (Tue 2027-09-07) runs 1.6-2.1x an ordinary post-payroll session in TLT/LQD/AGG/IEF with no directional edge; that ledger's finding transfers to this date and should be read before any stance is written here. (2) It falls the day BEFORE fomc-blackout-start-2027-09-04, so it is the last payroll the Committee can be spoken to about. HONEST LIMITS. STATUS IS ESTIMATE AND MUST STAY THERE until bls.gov's 2027 schedule is actually retrieved; promotion trigger is any successful fetch of it naming this date, which flips the prefix to BLS: and the status to confirmed. impact high and symbols [] match every other jobs-* entry. Estimates widen caution and license no entry.
